ModMetaData.name: 鼠族缩放缓存线程安全修复 / NewRatkin Draw Scale Cache Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复 NewRatkinPlus 在 RimWorld 1.7 多线程绘制下，GeneDrawScaleCache 用普通 Dictionary 缓存鼠族体型缩放时被并发读写、抛出 InvalidOperationException 并可能留下损坏缓存的问题。只给 GeneDrawScaleCache.Get 与 Recalculate(Pawn, out float) 加同一个互斥锁，保留原有缓存与缩放行为。不改工坊文件或存档。
Fixes NewRatkinPlus 1.7's GeneDrawScaleCache using a non-thread-safe Dictionary while Waylith pre-draws pawns on worker threads. Serializes GeneDrawScaleCache.Get and Recalculate(Pawn, out float) with one monitor; cache values, gene behavior and draw scale remain unchanged. No Workshop or save files are modified.
